description: Palettes generated using prime number gaps as hue spacing

math_basis.note: Prime gaps are differences between consecutive primes. Irregular but deterministic. Scale factor maps gap magnitude to hue degrees.

palettes.name: Prime Gap 6-color (scale=30)
palettes.aesthetic_notes: Controlled chaos. Small gaps cluster; large prime gaps (twin primes) create jumps. Deterministic but feels random.

palettes.name: Prime Gap 8-color (scale=50)
palettes.aesthetic_notes: High scale factor amplifies prime gap drama. Wide spacing with occasional clusters at twin primes.

palettes.name: Prime Density Dark Palette
palettes.aesthetic_notes: Low lightness, medium scale. Good for dark-mode UIs or night-sky aesthetics. Prime gaps give it organic irregularity.
